title: Introduce onboarding telemetry snapshots and human-friendly release stubs
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add telemetry snapshot export for onboarding and generate concise human-friendly release stubs for new model versions. Backfill utilities and a lightweight opt-in preview endpoint for release drafting.
description: Context & motivation: We frequently get noisy, low-signal onboarding churn in release notes because engineers must manually synthesize perf telemetry into a digest. This PR introduces two related capabilities: (1) telemetry snapshots — compact, schema-stable exports that capture onboarding-run aggregates (latency p50/p95, memory, token mix, occupancy, sample counts, and a tiny sparsed-coverage fingerprint) and (2) release stubs — an auto-drafted, human-readable release text generated from the snapshot plus curated heuristics so PMs/engineers can quickly iterate on the final release notes. Goals: reduce manual drafting time, surface meaningful perf regressions and resource-affecting changes, and enable quick previews for stakeholders. Summary of changes: - telemetry: new snapshot exporter and backfill tool (python) that converts onboarding-run telemetry into the compact snapshot schema. - release stubs: a generation module that maps snapshot signals to templated release sentences and a preview endpoint (opt-in flag) that returns both JSON fragment and natural language suggestions. - UX & safety: authored templates are intentionally conservative (flagged suggestions), templates can be overridden via repo config. - tests & CI: unit tests for the exporter, golden snapshots for a small set of canonical onboard runs, e2e smoke test for the preview endpoint. Checklist: - [x] snapshot schema and docs - [x] exporter implementation and unit tests - [x] release-stub generator + templates - [x] preview endpoint and e2e smoke tests - [x] migration/backfill tool (dry-run mode) - [x] add integration test to model onboarding pipeline - [x] engineering review and perf validation (see post-merge) Related work: follows pattern from ENG-1472 (profile rollups) and complements ENG-1519 (changelog heuristics). There is a support ticket SUP-9021 asking for quicker human-ready release notes for compliance reviews. HOW TO REVIEW: focus on snapshot schema stability (telemetry/snapshot.py), the generator heuristics (release_stub/generator.py), and the preview endpoint behavior (api/preview.py). Backfill is safe by default (dry-run) but review migration script for runtime cost.

diff_snippets:
--- telemetry/snapshot.py (new)
+class SnapshotV1:
+    """Compact onboarding telemetry snapshot: p50/p95, occupancy, token_mix, sample_count, fingerprint"""
+    fields = ['p50_ms','p95_ms','occupancy','token_mix','samples','fingerprint']

--- release_stub/generator.py
-def generate_stub(snapshot):
-    # simple heuristics
-    return []
+def generate_stub(snapshot):
+    # map perf delta -> readable sentence templates
+    suggestions = []
+    if snapshot['p95_ms'] > snapshot['baseline_p95_ms'] * 1.25:
+        suggestions.append('Notable increase in tail latency compared to baseline (~25%+). Investigate attention kernel pairing.')
review_conversation: Arjun Patel: Left a few nits on naming (snapshot vs rollup) and suggested making fingerprint explanation inline in the schema docs.
Maya Chen: Thanks Arjun — renamed SnapshotRollup -> SnapshotV1 and added inline docstring and example payload to docs/onboarding/release-stubs.md
Sofia Martinez: Can we make the preview endpoint opt-in behind a feature flag? We do not want auto-drafted content to appear in every onboarding pipeline run.
Maya Chen: Preview endpoint is opt-in by default and requires onboarding run to set 'release_preview=true' in the metadata. Updated api/preview.py to enforce permission checks.
Evan Liu: CI showed a flaky test on the backfill script in CI matrix; I re-ran tests and the backfill temporary file cleanup was fixed in the recent commit.
Sofia Martinez: Approved after small doc clarifications.
Arjun Patel: Approved - left one suggestion about making template phrases shorter for internationalization (not blocking).

migration_instructions: scripts/backfill_onboard_snapshots.py --dry-run (recommended) then --run with --concurrency=4; snapshots are written to s3://redwood-model-registry/onboard-snapshots/v1/

Backfill tested in dry-run under CI matrix. Manual QA: run onboarding pipeline with release_preview and review generated stub in staging console.
notes_for_release_manager: This change introduces new artifacts (snapshot JSON and release stub). Add a bullet to release notes: 'Onboarding telemetry snapshots and auto-drafted release stubs (opt-in preview)'. No changes to public API; feature gated behind onboarding metadata flag.
